<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The '''Gravity Device''' is a block that raises gravity inside a sealed room, turning it into a personal training chamber. Combined with [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]], it is the fastest way to grind stats, Training Points and mastery outside the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]].

<!--T:6-->
This page covers how to build and use the machine. For what gravity does to you, see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity|Gravity]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Crafting == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The top slot takes any weight item (Turtle Shell, Workout Weights or Weighted Cape). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar#Radar parts|Dragon Radar]].
</translate>
{{Recipe|gravity_device}}

<translate>
== Setting it up == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
# '''Build a sealed room.''' The device needs an enclosed room between '''5 and 25 blocks on each side''' by default. It scans the space and only works if the room is properly closed off (see the next section).
# '''Place the Gravity Device''' inside the room.
# '''Power it with Star Energy.''' Like Dr. Kikono's Station, the device runs on Star Energy: connect it to a '''Fuel Generator''' (which burns furnace fuel) with '''Energy Cables''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor#Star Energy|Armor]]). Its buffer holds up to '''20,000''' energy.
# '''Set the target gravity''' in the device's menu: type a value and press '''Set''', anywhere from '''1× up to 1000×'''. Then press '''Turn On'''.
# While it is on, powered and the room is valid, '''everyone inside the room feels that gravity''', added on top of the dimension's own gravity. A visual effect covers the screen, growing with the device's gravity up to full intensity at 60×.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:11-->
The menu shows the stored energy and the device status:
</translate>
{{#invoke:Recipes|screen|gravity_device}}
{| class="wikitable"

<translate>
<!--T:22-->
'''Energy cost:''' the device burns '''1 energy per second for each × of gravity''', so 100× gravity costs 100 energy per second. Higher gravity drains the buffer faster, so keep fuel flowing. If several devices overlap, the strongest one applies.
</translate>

<translate>
== Building the room == <!--T:23-->

<!--T:24-->
The device checks the room by '''flood-filling outward''' from itself in every direction. A spot only counts as "inside the room" if it is '''completely empty''' (no collision at all). This means:

<!--T:25-->
* '''Any block seals the room.''' Stone, wood, glass, slabs, stairs, carpets and other blocks all work as walls, floor and ceiling.
* '''Doors and trapdoors always seal the room''', open or closed, so you can use them as an entrance.
* The '''empty space inside''' must measure '''between 5 and 25 blocks on every axis''' by default. If it is smaller or bigger, or if any gap lets the scan escape, the menu shows '''Invalid room (5-25 blocks each side)''' and the device won't apply gravity.
* The device doesn't need to be centered or on the floor: place it anywhere inside the sealed space.
* The room is checked again every 5 seconds while the device is on, so breaking a wall switches the gravity off.
</translate>

{{Note|type=tip|title=<translate><!--T:26--> Quick checklist</translate>|<translate><!--T:27--> Build a fully enclosed box using only full blocks, with doors or trapdoors for the entrance. Keep the inside between 5 and 25 blocks on all three axes. Place the device anywhere inside, power it, set a gravity and turn it on: the menu should show Active.</translate>}}

<translate>
== Using it with weights == <!--T:28-->

<!--T:29-->
Gravity and weights multiply each other, and this is the key combo:

<!--T:30-->
* Your '''effective weight''' is your worn weight multiplied by gravity. Weights that barely register at normal gravity are pushed into the '''Ideal''' or '''Pushing Hard''' training zone under a gravity machine, giving the big '''×2 to ×2.5 TP''' multiplier.
* Gravity also adds a '''flat bonus''': about '''+2.5% TP and +0.25% mastery per point of net gravity'''.

<!--T:31-->
The trade-off: high gravity also '''weakens and slows you'''. Movement, jumping and flight are penalized, and overloading yourself with too much weight cuts your stats. Find a gravity and weight combo that keeps your load in the '''Ideal''' zone for safe, fast training, or push into the heavy zone for maximum gains while you accept being weaker. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity|Gravity]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity Room upgrades == <!--T:32-->

<!--T:33-->
Bulma can upgrade your device through two sidequests, '''Gravity Room Mk.II''' and '''Gravity Room Mk.III'''. Once completed, they cut the stat penalty from overloading on weights '''while you're inside an active device's room'''. Mk.III cuts more than Mk.II, and the help shrinks as you get stronger (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity#Gravity Room upgrades|Gravity]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Recommended loop == <!--T:34-->

<!--T:35-->
Build a sealed room, power the device, equip weights, set a gravity you can handle, then train (fight, spar or grind) inside. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points and Mastery]] for everything that grants TP and mastery.
</translate>
